config.autoReveal.description: Show the Monitor Dotnet panel when a debug session starts.
config.bridgePath.markdownDescription: Path to the bridge assembly (`MonitorDotnet.Bridge.dll`). Leave empty to use the copy bundled with the extension.
config.chartWindowSeconds.description: How many seconds of data to show on the Performance charts.
config.counterProviders.markdownDescript: Counter providers (EventCounters). Specify a provider name (`System.Runtime`) or exact counters (`MyProvider[Counter1,Counter2]`).
config.dotnetPath.description: Path to the dotnet executable used to run the bridge and external profiling tools.
config.enableIssueDetection.description: Detect performance issues and mark their time ranges on the charts.
config.enableMonitoring.enum0: Start monitoring automatically when a .NET project is debugged or run.
config.enableMonitoring.enum1: Start monitoring automatically only when debugging.
config.enableMonitoring.enum2: Do not start monitoring automatically (manual start and attach remain available).
config.enableMonitoring.markdownDescript: When to start monitoring automatically: **on debug or run**, **on debug only**, or **never**.
config.metricProviders.markdownDescripti: Meters (`System.Diagnostics.Metrics`). `*` means all meters, or use `MyMeter` / `MyMeter\MyInstrument`.
config.processNameFilter.description: Extra filter for finding the debuggee process (a substring of the command line).
config.profilingOutputDirectory.descript: Directory for profiles, dumps and snapshots. Empty means the .monitor-dotnet folder in the project.
config.traceProfile.markdownDescription: Providers recorded by `dotnet-trace`. `default` keeps the tool's own set (it includes CPU sampling).
config.traceProfile.enum.default: The tool's default set: CPU sampling plus the main runtime events.
config.traceProfile.enum.dotnetCommon: Lightweight runtime diagnostics: GC, JIT, loader, exceptions and threading.
config.traceProfile.enum.dotnetSampledTh: Samples managed stacks to estimate the wall-clock time spent in code.
config.traceProfile.enum.gcVerbose: GC collections plus object allocation samples: for allocation and GC investigations.
config.traceProfile.enum.gcCollect: GC collections only, with very low overhead.
config.traceProfile.enum.database: ADO.NET and Entity Framework database commands.
config.traceDurationSeconds.description: How many seconds to record the profile for. 0 means the recording runs until you stop it.
config.dumpType.markdownDescription: Kind of memory dump taken by `dotnet-dump`: `Full` (all memory), `Heap` (stacks and managed memory), `Mini` (modules, threads, stacks) or `Triage` (like Mini without personal data).
config.dumpType.enum.full: All memory including module images: the largest dump.
config.dumpType.enum.heap: Stacks and managed memory without mapped images: the usual choice.
config.dumpType.enum.mini: Modules, threads, stacks and exception information only.
config.dumpType.enum.triage: Like Mini, but with personal data removed.
config.dumpCrashReport.description: Add a crash report to the memory dump (`dotnet-dump collect --crashreport`).
config.refreshIntervalSeconds.descriptio: How often to refresh counters and metrics (in seconds).
description: Monitor .NET applications while debugging: CPU load, memory, garbage collection, counters, metrics and environment variables.
